Personal data: seed_data.json (byte-identical in environment/assets and solution/app/src) has 10 users and 16 applications with generic synthetic names; every email is on RFC 2606 reserved domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example); no phone numbers (only ISO dates match a phone regex), no addresses, DOB, IDs or URLs; message bodies are 12 templated lines with (#NNN) counters plus 7 short greetings; the 3 notes are benign interview remarks. Host paths: scan for drive letters, /home/, /Users/, workspace name, user name and user id found none; all paths are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests). Remote fetch: only URLs are http://localhost:3000 / 127.0.0.1:3000 (prompts, app_context, test.sh) and https://openrouter.ai/api in the frozen verifier env (judge endpoint, not a grading dependency on an outside site; Colderwater lesson 13 pattern absent from judge prompts). Solution fetches only same-origin (public/js/app.js:29 fetch(path, credentials:'same-origin'), :150 EventSource('/api/events')); no CDN in index.html. Images pin npm versions (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7); apt packages and base-image tags are unpinned but those Dockerfiles are byte-identical to the template (diff SAME) and unpinned apt is a NOTE per the skill contract.
